probes.prompt: /grafana-assistant:grafana-assistant-cli Use the grafana-assistant skill to author the CLI's local configuration file for this concrete two-instance scenario. Headless authoring task: no network, no real Grafana instance, no install, no browser auth; the skill's own text forbids auto-installing grafana-assistant, so actually running any grafana-assistant subcommand and any live Grafana connection stay untested. Write grafana-assistant.yaml using ONLY the config file format documented in this skill, for this scenario: instance dev-local with url http://localhost:3000 and the literal token glsa_dev_7f3k; instance acme-prod with url https://observability.acme-corp.grafana.net whose service-account token must use the skill's documented env-var expansion form ${ACME_PROD_GRAFANA_TOKEN} and must never be inlined; current-instance set to acme-prod; one project named payments-api at ~/work/payments-api; and tunnel security exactly as follows: the filesystem tool with allowed_paths including /var/log/payments-api and deny_paths including **/*.key, and the terminal tool with allowed_commands including git and kubectl, deny_commands including rm -rf, and passthrough_env including KUBECONFIG. Do not invent config keys, instances, or sections that the documented config format does not define. Then read the immutable verify_grafana_config.py and run exactly python verify_grafana_config.py using Bash; that validates the documented YAML structure and writes grafana-verification.json. Do not modify the verifier or read/write its skill output file with model tools; the runner inspects it directly. This is the only allowed Bash command, without prefixes, suffixes, redirection or extra shell operations. Final response: name the produced file, report the actual verifier result, and state that a live Grafana connection and real CLI execution remain untested.

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

text = Path('grafana-assistant.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert re.search(r"(?m)^current-instance:\s*['\"]?acme-prod['\"]?\s*$", text), 'current-instance must be acme-prod'
assert re.search(r"(?m)^instances:", text), 'missing top-level instances block'
assert re.search(r"(?m)^\s+acme-prod:\s*$", text), 'missing acme-prod instance entry under instances'
assert re.search(r"(?m)^\s+dev-local:\s*$", text), 'missing dev-local instance entry under instances'
assert re.search(r"url:\s*https://observability\.acme-corp\.grafana\.net", text), 'prod url missing or wrong'
assert re.search(r"token:\s*['\"]?\$\{ACME_PROD_GRAFANA_TOKEN\}['\"]?", text), 'prod token must use the documented ${VAR} env-var expansion'
assert re.search(r"url:\s*http://localhost:3000", text), 'dev url missing or wrong'
assert re.search(r"token:\s*['\"]?glsa_dev_7f3k['\"]?\s*(#.*)?$", text, re.M), 'dev token must be the literal glsa_dev_7f3k'
assert text.count('glsa_') == 1, 'a literal token may appear only for dev-local; never inline a prod secret'
assert re.search(r"(?m)^projects:", text), 'missing top-level projects block'
assert re.search(r"name:\s*['\"]?payments-api['\"]?", text), 'missing payments-api project name'
assert re.search(r"path:\s*['\"]?~/work/payments-api['\"]?", text), 'missing payments-api project path'
assert re.search(r"(?m)^tunnel:", text), 'missing top-level tunnel block'
assert 'allowed_paths:' in text and '/var/log/payments-api' in text, 'filesystem allowed_paths must include /var/log/payments-api'
assert 'deny_paths:' in text and '**/*.key' in text, 'filesystem deny_paths must include **/*.key'
assert 'allowed_commands:' in text and re.search(r"\bgit\b", text) and re.search(r"\bkubectl\b", text), 'terminal allowed_commands must include git and kubectl'
assert 'deny_commands:' in text and 'rm -rf' in text, 'terminal deny_commands must include rm -rf'
assert 'passthrough_env:' in text and 'KUBECONFIG' in text, 'passthrough_env must include KUBECONFIG'
for invented in ('password:', 'api_key:', 'bearer:'):
    assert invented not in text, 'invented config key not in the documented schema: ' + invented
report = {'current_instance': True, 'dev_instance': True, 'no_invented_keys': True,
          'prod_env_expansion': True, 'project_entry': True, 'single_literal_token': True,
          'tunnel_security': True}
Path('grafana-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('Grafana assistant config: documented two-instance YAML structure checks passed; live Grafana connection and CLI execution remain untested')
